capabilities: Copy the current selection or whole note as cleaned Markdown to the clipboard
Strip Obsidian-specific syntax such as wikilinks, embeds, callouts, frontmatter, comments, tags and footnotes
Protect fenced code, inline code and $$math$$ blocks from conversion
Run from the command palette, ribbon, editor context menu or file explorer menu on desktop and mobile
extras: The README lists known limitations, including that inline $...$ math is not individually protected and standard links to local .md files will not navigate inside MarginNote.
problem: Obsidian-only syntax like wikilinks, embeds, callouts, frontmatter, comments and highlights fails to render or leaks hidden content when pasted into other Markdown apps.

relations.evidence: so it renders correctly in MarginNote 4 and any other Markdown app

summary: Copy tool that converts notes or selections to clean, standard Markdown by stripping Obsidian-specific syntax for use in MarginNote 4 and other Markdown apps.
